name: Spellcaster
description:
Draw glowing runes with your mouse to cast spells on your desktop.

Press Super+Z (or the Copilot key), draw a rune and let go:
Spiral: Fireball (close window)
Zig-zag: Lightning (launch an app)
Circle: Portal (show desktop)
V: Freeze (lock screen)
Λ: Summon your familiar
U: Sound Control (scroll for volume)
Triangle: Farewell (log out)
Line up: Spellbook (settings)
Line down: Slumber (suspend)

Every rune can be rebound in the Spellbook.
